verdicts.rationale: Agree the missing state must be visible text (today: class, title and sr-only only, READ ui/pi-common.js:423-446) and that the note overstates what moves (runtime skips keys the snapshot lacks, READ src/rotation.ts:16-26). Four power-user regressions in the proposal as written. (1) The pill wording 'not in HWiNFO' eats the only identity a missing member has (its raw key, or its rotation name): MEASURED at 189 px the raw key keeps 55 of 106 px with 'not in HWiNFO' vs 92 with 'missing'; chip also on dial: 31 vs 60; at 160 px: 26 vs 63. In the detail tile editor at 189 px: 67 of 106 px today, 0 with 'not in HWiNFO', 16 with 'missing'. (2) Counting only live members makes the note contradict the chips it points at ('these 2' under 3 chips) and aria-setsize/posinset and Earlier/Later, which all work on stored positions; a power user needs both numbers. (3) When the ON-DIAL reading is the missing one, nothing moves at all: advance() and the auto cycle return early (READ src/actions/sensor-dial.ts:521-526 and 709-711), yet MEASURED dial-missing note says 'Rotation moves through these 2 readings only'; a live count of 1 would still promise movement. (4) Detail lists do not skip: a missing member keeps its place and draws 'Sensor missing' (READ src/detail/detail-group.ts:14, detail-faces.ts:95), so 'skipped' wording or a live count must not leak into the detail editor or the Press summary ('custom list of 5' counts stored keys, which is what the tiles draw).
verdicts.regression_risk: Wider chips wrap rows sooner; the note changes when a tree refresh brings a member back and is announced on the 'rotation' live channel; e2e option-name assertions change; a live count computed over keys instead of measurements double-counts a confirmed link's two endpoints (runtime collapses them, rotation.ts:21).
verdicts.revised_correction: Pill text 'missing' (the device face's own word, 'Sensor missing'), flex:none, and let a missing chip wrap its pill under the name (flex-wrap on .hw-set-chip.missing) whenever the name would fall below about 60 px; drop the sr-only duplicate so AT hears it once. Rotation note keeps the stored count and names the skip: 'Rotation moves through 2 of these 3 readings, in this order; the missing one is skipped until HWiNFO lists it again.' Live count deduplicated by measurement (sameReading), mirroring pickedReadings. When the on-dial reading is missing: 'Nothing moves while the reading on the dial is missing; pick another or wait for it to return.' Detail editor: the pill only, no skip wording, stored count unchanged.
